requiredFindings.title: Specify independent carrier absence observations and rechecks
requiredFindings.finding: The plan relies on selection already recording opensip.json absence and the marker observation covering absent .opensip. At the pinned base Selected.config is only a boolean and ProjectRootAdmission::recheck never checks the config name. observe_marker returns the same MarkerObservation::Absent for a missing .opensip and for a present .opensip without project-id.v1. Thus opensip.json can appear after selection, or an initially absent .opensip can appear containing local.json but no marker, without either inherited recheck detecting it. The chain checks identity/birth and custody, not unchanged directory mtime. Section 0 also incorrectly describes every inherited field as a full DescriptorMetadata equality check.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Specify explicit charged negative observations for opensip.json and, in interactive mode, local.json or its absent .opensip parent, retained against the appropriate parent and rechecked under the fence. Keep CI free of local-carrier lookups. Correct the inherited-recheck facts. Add controls for opensip.json appearing after absence and .opensip appearing with local.json but no project-id.v1, in addition to the existing absent-leaf control.

requiredFindings.title: Resolve the exception-list conflict with the accepted law
requiredFindings.finding: MB item 9 says the audited list holds exactly git_tracking::process_environment and the test-only crash-matrix seams. LD-B1B-3 explicitly adds other fixture reads on the ground that they are equally test-only, while section 4 claims no law change. That expands an exact exception set without a corresponding accepted authority. Moreover the plan says it lists each exception but supplies only a category, not the concrete items the promised pin test would audit. Existing reads include custody HOME fixtures, host admission RUSTC/CARGO/helper reads, journal child helpers and fence/root test helpers. The section 2 controls also omit MB item 9's hostile-environment byte-equivalence control.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Either remove/inject the non-authorized fixture environment dependencies so the accepted list is obeyed, or explicitly obtain the required law correction before implementing expanded exceptions. Enumerate every allowed item and reason, with cfg(test)/test-target confinement, rather than a broad fixture category; pin that concrete list. Include the required hostile HOME/PATH/CI/XDG_* invariance control, preserving the refusal-only Git outcome exception.

requiredFindings.title: Make preservation of legacy admission behavior explicit
requiredFindings.finding: The compatibility wrapper is specified as exactly the composition of a phase that captures carriers and a registry phase. Existing read-session and write-gate admissions do not read configuration bytes, accept no invocation-mode argument and charge no carrier reads. Composing the new phases therefore adds I/O, budget consumption and new race/read failures to existing callers; choosing non-interactive alone still reads opensip.json. Interactive use could also introduce local.json refusals. The asserted unchanged behavior does not follow from the proposed API, and no compatibility control is provided.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Define an explicit non-capturing legacy path or policy that preserves the old callers' reads, charges, refusals and mode behavior, while requiring the analysis path to capture carriers before configuration/pack resolution and registry capture. Identify how read-session and write-gate wrappers use that path, retaining their rechecks and latching behavior. Add focused compatibility controls demonstrating no added carrier reads or local probing, and retain the refused-pack pre-registry control for the analysis path.
